info.description: HTTP API for customer clients and custom connectors. Authenticate with JSON at POST /api/v1/auth/login for local accounts, or use the SSO start/browser/exchange flow. When challenge_required is true, complete /auth/login/verify with the emailed code before receiving a JWT. Pass the returned FactoryVPN JWT as a bearer token. Access is restricted to assigned resource groups. Delegated administration requires the operation's capability within those groups; global administrators manage the instance. The API controls sessions; machine traffic requires a separately provisioned OpenVPN client. Use your deployment's API origin, not the public documentation website. Worker and gateway machine operations are intentionally excluded.
info.title: FactoryVPN Customer API

post.description:
Request assistance using the gateway's configured activation mode.

Provide exactly one of gateway_id or phone_number. HTTP 200 does not imply an
active VPN: inspect status, which may be REQUESTED or FAILED. Poll the detail
until gateway_ready_at is set, connect the technician VPN, then wait for ACTIVE.
Sessions last at most 30 minutes, bounded by the opening browser/SSO lifetime;
each peer has one reserved session. Browser logout closes its associated VPNs.
Optional Idempotency-Key (UUID) recovers the same request for this account,
including terminal outcomes, without resending SMS. Changed input returns 409.
